data.one_liner: Simplifies hero transitions between grid and list views in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides seamless hero animations and transitions between grid and list layouts. It supports customizable card content, styling, loading shimmer effects, and dark/light themes.
use_when: You need smooth transitions between grid and list views for items.
You want built-in support for themes, responsive design, and loading shimmer effects on cards.
avoid_when: You only need standard page routing without grid-to-list item view transformations.
You require a complex layout engine that doesn't fit standard grid-list structures.
strengths: Easy transitions between grid and list views
Customizable cards with dark/light theme support and loading states
Cross-platform support including web, mobile, and desktop
weaknesses: Limited to list and grid view transition use cases
Relies on specific model structures for items
data.minimal_example:
LocalHeroViews(
  tabController: tabController,
  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
  itemCount: itemsMode.length,
  itemsModel: (index) => ItemsModel(
    name: Text(itemsMode[index].name),
    title: Text(itemsMode[index].title),
    subTitle: Text(itemsMode[index].subTitle),
    favoriteIconButton: IconButton(onPressed: () {}, icon: Icon(Icons.add)),
    image: DecorationImage(image: NetworkImage(itemsMode[index].imageUri)),
  ),
);
